baseline_models.mechanism: The question stages the report as something that has arrived, then lets the predecessors' tasted experience travel with it. Hearing is therefore an encounter with an embodied outcome, not receipt of detached information.

activation_trace.role: Literal coming and arrival makes the report an event that reaches the present addressees.
A consequential report that is brought and conveyed supplies the content carried into the encounter.
Experienced trial makes the reported content a lived result rather than secondhand data.

changed_reading.before: A report about earlier disbelievers has been communicated.
changed_reading.after: Their lived outcome arrives inside the report, placing present hearers at an encounter rather than at historical distance.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: فَذَاقُوا۟ وَبَالَ أَمْرِهِمْ وَلَهُمْ عَذَابٌ أَلِيمٌۭ
baseline_models.mechanism: Taste makes consequence an intake; the unwholesome, heavy yield is grammatically tied to their own affair, while the following punishment remains a further phase. The ayah distinguishes an already sampled consequence from pain still held for them.

activation_trace.role: Literal tasting by the mouth gives the consequence the form of bodily intake and sampling.
Unwholesomeness that cannot be assimilated makes their affair's yield turn against the one taking it in.
The literal affair or condition supplies the source whose own outcome is being tasted.
Literal punitive pain marks the subsequent punishment as distinct from the consequence already sampled.

changed_reading.before: They suffered the consequence of what they did and will be punished.
changed_reading.after: They sampled an unassimilable yield generated by their own affair, and that experienced sample precedes the painful punishment still held for them.

baseline_models.mechanism: Those characterized by covering truth become themselves uncovered as a report and forced into experiential knowledge. Concealment therefore fails twice: their history becomes communicable evidence, and the truth they screened off becomes something tasted.

activation_trace.role: Literal covering supplies concealment as the action whose failure structures the reading.
Screening off truth identifies what the predecessors attempted to keep from governing their response.
The conveyed report turns the coverers themselves into disclosed evidence for later hearers.
Directly undergoing and learning by trial reverses screened-off truth into unavoidable experience.

changed_reading.before: The ayah reports that unbelievers were punished.
changed_reading.after: The ayah performs a reversal in which coverers become public evidence and what they covered becomes experiential knowledge.

context_deltas.mechanism: The immediately preceding contrast between concealed and declared material sharpens the focus report into an exposure operation. What originates inwardly and can be covered is already open to knowledge, then becomes outward evidence through the arriving report.

activation_trace.role: Literal covering anchors the focus-side attempt to keep something from view.
A report brought to hearers is the focus-side vehicle by which the covered history becomes public.
Literal disclosure to a knower removes epistemic shelter and licenses the exposure mechanism.
Hiding something inwardly supplies the concealed pole that the report reverses.
Manifesting and declaring supplies the outward pole reached when history becomes report.
An inward source from which acts issue connects hidden disposition to the affair whose consequence is exposed.

structural_cues: 64:4 immediately precedes the focus and coordinates what is concealed with what is declared.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies covering, inward concealment, outward manifestation, and a source of acts; I infer that the report moves material from concealment into evidence. A live alternative is that 64:4 asserts exhaustive knowledge without describing the report's operation.

changed_reading.before: The report happens to tell later listeners what occurred.
changed_reading.after: The report is the outward phase of an exposure process: covered inward action issues in consequence and becomes publicly knowable history.

context_deltas.mechanism: The focus asks whether the predecessors' report has come to the current audience; the next ayah says messengers had come to those predecessors with disclosure, after which they covered and turned away. The same arrival structure recursively transfers the predecessors' decision point to the present hearers, who can themselves become report-material.

activation_trace.role: Arrival brings the prior people's report into the present audience's situation.
The conveyed consequential report is the object recursively transmitted to a new audience.
The repeated literal coming mirrors the focus arrival and supplies the earlier iteration of the same encounter.
Messengers and message identify what arrived in the predecessors' iteration of the pattern.
Disclosure by speech or sign makes that earlier arrival an intelligible communication rather than a bare event.
Covering truth supplies the predecessor response that the current audience is at risk of repeating.
Literal turning away completes the failed encounter and gives the recursion its causal hinge.

structural_cues: 64:6 explicitly gives a cause and repeats the sequence arrival, disclosed communication, covering, and turning.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies matching arrival roots and the response sequence; I infer a recursive role transfer from earlier recipients to current recipients. The alternative is a simpler causal explanation of the predecessors with no implication that the audience may occupy their role.

changed_reading.before: A historical warning reaches the current audience.
changed_reading.after: The warning reenacts the earlier messenger-arrival: current hearers now occupy the predecessors' former decision point and may become the next reported case.

context_deltas.mechanism: The report from before is followed by a future in which deniers are raised and emphatically informed of their own deeds. News thus moves in both temporal directions: a past outcome arrives now, while the present hearer is projected toward becoming the recipient and subject of a future report.

activation_trace.role: Literal temporal priority locates the first report in a past that advances toward the hearer.
The consequential report supplies the informational form shared across the temporal fold.
An assertion without certainty supplies the denial that future notification will overturn.
Stirring the stationary from rest moves the denier into the future scene of compulsory knowing.
Future conveyed information echoes the focus report and makes the hearer a later recipient of news about the self.
Intended action supplies the personal content that will later be reported back to its doer.

structural_cues: 64:7 moves from a claim about never being raised to emphatic future passive verbs for being raised and being informed.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies past priority, repeated report language, future raising, and deeds; I infer a deliberate temporal fold that turns report-hearers into future report-subjects. The alternative is that the two notifications are related only by topic.

changed_reading.before: The focus looks backward to a completed example.
changed_reading.after: The backward report opens a forward mirror: present deeds are on their way to becoming news delivered back to the doer.

context_deltas.mechanism: In the focus, people cover truth and taste the loss-bearing result of their affair; in 64:9, the same root supplies God's covering of their bads within a scene of mutual loss. Covering is not intrinsically condemned: agent and object reverse its function, from screening truth to shielding a person from the effects of wrong.

activation_trace.role: Covering truth supplies the destructive configuration whose result is tasted in the focus.
Heavy harmful consequence gives the truth-covering configuration its negative return.
Erasing a wrong by covering it supplies the protective reversal of the focus root's operation.
Loss or withheld value in an exchange frames both configurations as outcomes whose value is disclosed at settlement.
What causes harm supplies the object that is beneficially covered rather than the truth that is destructively covered.

structural_cues: 64:9 places belief and sound action before a causative use of the focus root, then entry and enduring success after it.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies two opposed covering branches and an exchange-loss frame; I infer a deliberate object reversal. The alternative is that the shared root carries separate conventional senses without inviting comparison.

changed_reading.before: Kufr is a fixed label for the punished group.
changed_reading.after: Kufr exposes a morally reversible operation: covering truth produces harmful return, while covering wrong protects its doer from that wrong's return.

context_deltas.mechanism: The focus affair yields a heavy, unassimilable return to its makers. The later loan sequence supplies the opposite economy: a portion deliberately released for recompense returns multiplied, its giver shielded, and even a little made visibly effective. Consequence is recast as patterned return, with contrary yields from contrary relations to what one holds.

activation_trace.role: An unwholesome yield supplies the negative return that cannot be comfortably taken in.
Their own affair identifies the originating activity to which the negative yield returns.
Cutting out wealth or work so its recompense returns supplies an explicit positive return mechanism.
Increase by another like amount gives the released good an amplifying rather than burdening yield.
Covering wrong and shielding its owner removes a harmful return within the positive economy.
Making a little suffice and show its effect explains how a small released portion can become a visible yield.

structural_cues: 64:17 forms one conditional chain from relinquished portion through multiplication and covering to appreciative restraint.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies a self-linked harmful consequence and an explicit loan-return chain; I infer that they are opposed return economies. The alternative is that the focus consequence and later reward are parallel outcomes without a shared circulation mechanism.

changed_reading.before: The predecessors receive punishment, while later givers receive reward.
changed_reading.after: The focus displays a negative return economy: their affair comes back as unwholesome weight, opposite to released good returning amplified and protective.

context_deltas.mechanism: The closing juxtaposition of what is hidden from sight and what is present under viewing sharpens the focus report as a converter of absence into testimony. The predecessors are temporally absent, but their consequential report makes that absence present and declarative for the hearer.

activation_trace.role: A consequential conveyed report is the focus instrument that transports an absent case.
Disclosure to the knower gives the report a ground beyond the current hearer's direct sight.
Being covered from eyes supplies the absent pole occupied by the earlier people and events.
Presence with observation supplies the mode into which the report brings the absent case.
Declaration grounded in knowledge makes that presence evidentiary rather than merely vivid.

structural_cues: The closing nominal sequence places the unseen and witnessed side by side after the historical report and future notification.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies report, hiddenness, presence, and knowledgeable declaration; I infer that the closing pair describes the report's epistemic work. The alternative is that 64:18 only names an unrestricted scope of knowledge.

changed_reading.before: The report recalls people no longer present.
changed_reading.after: The report converts a sight-hidden past into present testimony, so temporal absence does not protect the hearer from its evidentiary force.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is surprising because it activates the non-dominant count/return mappings attached to the context's enemy root and carries them back to the focus's before. It remains anchored in the arriving report of prior people and in the context's relocation of enmity into intimate relations. Downstream prose should call it a form-distant recurrence echo, not equate enemy lexically with return or counting.

activation_trace.role: What advances from an earlier time anchors the old case that may press into the present.
The report brought forward is the carrier by which the prior pattern can become current.
Literal enmity relocates the site of dangerous refusal from remote peoples into the nearest social bonds.
The split-root image of time recurring activates periodic repetition within the report's before-to-now movement.
The split-root image of return after departure supplies the exploratory arrow by which an old refusal pattern reappears.

changed_reading.before: Those before are safely remote outsiders whose failure is recalled.
changed_reading.after: The arrived report can stage prior refusal as a recurring pattern capable of returning inside the hearer's closest present relations.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This cross-domain reading uses rare material branches: rain, intake, an outlet, runoff-holding soil, and cultivation form an analogy rather than a lexical gloss. It remains anchored in tasting the focus's heavy rain-like consequence and in the cited context sequence. Render it only as an exploratory flow model in which retained circulation becomes harmful, not as the exclusive meaning of the ayah.

activation_trace.role: Literal mouth-taste turns consequence into material intake within the flow analogy.
Heavy rain supplies the focus-side inflow whose management can nourish or overwhelm.
Failure to assimilate makes the heavy inflow harmful to the receiving body or ground.
Rain descending and settling reinforces the contextual image of consequence arriving as a downward flow.
The non-dominant split-root image of exhausting affliction carries the material descent into experienced burden.
A penetrating tunnel with an outlet supplies egress as the opposite of blocked accumulation.
Ground that holds back its runoff gives possessive withholding a hydrological blockage image.
The farmer who cleaves soil supplies productive opening and cultivation as the flow model's successful alternative.

changed_reading.before: Wabal is simply a figurative label for a heavy consequence.
changed_reading.after: Wabal can be carried experimentally as failed circulation: heavy inflow becomes unassimilable where the receiving self holds runoff, while release and opening permit a different yield.

strongest_changes: The report reenacts the earlier arrival of messengers and places current hearers at the same decision point.
Past report and future self-notification fold together, making present deeds incipient news.
Covering reverses by agent and object: covering truth produces harmful return, while covering wrong protects from its effects.
The focus consequence can be read as a negative return economy opposed to the multiplying return of released good.
summary.what_was_special: The focus-only reading already made news embodied and consequence ingestive; context activated recursive transmission, temporal folding, reversible covering, opposed return economies, and two contained form-distant models of recurrence and material circulation without forcing them into one interpretation.
remaining_uncertainties: The recursive and temporal-fold readings may be rhetorical echoes rather than full role transfers.
The return-economy relation depends on a reader-supplied causal analogy between separated sequences.
The recurrence and hydrology outliers depend on non-dominant or rare branches and must remain explicitly exploratory.
The already-tasted consequence and the later painful punishment may be two phases or two descriptions of one outcome.
